items.title: TRex Bio prices $117M 首次公開上市（IPO） to support immune drug work
items.summary: Eli Lilly is the largest equity holder in TRex, which is developing drugs that treat immunological conditions by activating “Treg” cells.

items.title: 美國國家衛生研究院（NIH）經費不確定性，阻礙美國研究人員
items.summary: 本週「The Readout LOUD」Podcast將探討美國國家衛生研究院（NIH）的預算運用，以及生技投資人為何感到悲觀。

items.title: Viatris boosts pain drug portfolio with $1.7B buyout of Pacira
items.summary: The deal hands Viatris two non-opioid pain treatments that booked nearly $700 million in 2025 but could soon lose patent protection. Viatris vowed to use its “intellectual property expertise” to sustain sales.

items.title: In the hunt for reverse merger targets, Caribou could be prized game
items.summary: The struggling 細胞治療 developer is exploring strategic alternatives, which, among other characteristics, make it a likely candidate to receive reverse merger interest.

items.title: Caribou to halt CAR-T細胞療法 work, lay off staff amid ‘challenging’ funding climate
items.summary: Despite having an 異體（取自捐贈者） 細胞治療 prospect that’s ready for late-stage testing in lymphoma, Caribou couldn’t secure funding to support the effort and will now pursue “strategic alternatives” instead.

items.title: Halozyme prevails in patent fight with Merck; Enliven readies anticipated leukemia trial
items.summary: A Dutch court barred Merck from selling subcutaneous Keytruda in several European countries. Elsewhere, an Insmed executive ended a seven-year run and two startups secured venture cash.
